n: A FortiCloud account with one registered device could log in to other customers' devices. Fortinet found it exploited by two FortiCloud accounts in January 2026 but does not say which products were hit. Only exposed with FortiCloud SSO admin login turned on (set admin-forticloud-sso-login disable turns it off).
Fortinet says it is not impacted.
